reason: PURE is the one I'd look at, because the Complex has citrate and that gives me cramps. The first thing I noticed was the sachets and the batch QR, which are nice for travel, but zero reviews and $1 a day is more than I pay for my usual bottle, so I'd scroll past.
objection: No reviews at all and I read reviews for 20 minutes before buying anything. $29.99 is a lot to risk on a brand nobody has tried, when a bottle of 100 to 120 capsules costs less.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews saying it doesn't upset the stomach, or a cheaper small trial box of 7 to 10 sachets.
